verificationMethod: Fresh review of exact official Supermicro model pages and dated OEM announcements; data changes are limited to positively documented claims.

claims.basis: The model page documents both air and liquid CPU cooling to 350 W and an optional D2C cold plate.

before.note: The H13 EPYC 4004 entry branch began in May 2024. The May 2025 EPYC 4005 announcement explicitly links AS-3015A-I; the exact original SKU debut has not been independently established here.

after.note: The 21 May 2024 EPYC 4004 announcement explicitly links AS-3015A-I under Tower Servers. This establishes the model by May 2024, not an exact first-sale date. The separate 13 May 2025 announcement documents its EPYC 4005 refresh.

claims.locator: 21 May 2024 dateline; Tower Servers exact product link
claims.basis: The exact tower SKU is linked in the 2024 announcement. The 2025 EPYC 4005 refresh event remains unchanged and was freshly reconfirmed in its separate May 13, 2025 OEM announcement.

unchangedBoundaries: Model-level CPU cooling is not a GPU/cooling qualification; GPU option cooling scopes were not expanded.
SBA-817V7-1N remains announced/Coming Soon. No exact shipping date was added.

validationChecks: Every new source URL is official Supermicro and targets the exact model or exact dated announcement.

AS-3015A-I remains Documented by 2024 and its EPYC 4005 refresh remains 2025.
